title: Is there ghost and tachyon free bounce in UV complete gravity theory?
summary: Analytic infinite derivative gravity theories provide a renormalizable and ghost-free description of gravity around covariantly constant backgrounds. These theories can have non-singular bouncing Universe solutions. In this paper we aim to address a question whether it is possible to realize a bouncing solution without the presence of a ghost or a tachyon instability in this framework. We perform a detailed analysis of degrees of freedom in $(1+3)$ formalism around Minkowski and de Sitter space-times.
